ai.overview: Arizona brings the College Basketball Belt to a neutral-site showdown against Colorado State on November 23, 2026. The Wildcats claimed the belt in their current reign and have yet to defend it, while the Rams are looking to capture the lineal title for what would be their third time in program history.
key_matchups: Arizona's four-game winning streak including victories over UConn and Auburn versus Colorado State's rebound from their 58-73 loss to Loyola Chicago
Historical series that has seen the lead change hands frequently, with Arizona holding a narrow 14-11 edge in the all-time head-to-head
Both teams enter at 4-1 on the season, but Arizona's recent resume features wins over stronger competition
ai.betting_angles: Arizona has won their last 4 games with impressive victories over UConn (85-79) and Auburn (80-69), while Colorado State's most recent win came against North Dakota State (71-64). The all-time series is surprisingly competitive at 14-11 in Arizona's favor across 25 meetings, though they haven't faced each other since 1978. Our Elo model makes Arizona a clear favorite in this neutral-site contest.
ai.prediction_writeup: Arizona's recent form has been dominant with four straight wins including quality victories over UConn and Auburn, while Colorado State is just 1-1 in their last two games after the loss to Loyola Chicago. Both teams sit at 4-1, but the Wildcats have faced tougher competition and shown the ability to win close games, as evidenced by their 85-79 victory over UConn. The Elo model favoring Arizona aligns with their current momentum and stronger resume. Arizona successfully defends the belt in their first title defense of this reign.
